title: Wellmanifest Metafile Event v1 Schema
description: Discrete append-only lifecycle event line in a JSONL metafile stream.

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the change.

event.description: Event name (e.g. created, scanned, ocr_extracted, staged, routed, verified, reconciled, synced, location_updated, corrected).

actor.description: Agent, user, or service performing the action.

node.description: Machine / cluster node where event occurred (e.g. android-phone, nvidia, lenovo).

delta.description: Modified fields (partial diff or updated slice).

snapshot.description: Optional full state snapshot at this point in time.
